comment: Melodies and basses for the music box. Each token is NOTE:SLOTS; a slot is an eighth note (slots_per_quarter 2). Bars are separated by | and every bar here is 8 slots. Notes are written in scientific pitch; R is a rest. Transcribed for this Jig from the tunes themselves; the tunes are old enough to be free (see README).

tunes.name: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star
tunes.credit: French air 'Ah! vous dirai-je, maman', first published 1761
